inline_comments.comment: The test verifies node `section` and `cssClasses` after the wrap, but `generateEdges` also derives `section-edge-${child.section}` and stores `section` directly on the edge (lines 306 and 324 in `mindmapDb.ts`). The original bug report described nodes that were visually "disconnected" — which is likely the edge color losing its theme class. Adding assertions on the edges corresponding to child12–child15 (e.g., `expect(edgeToChild12.section).toBe(0)` and checking `edgeToChild12.classes` includes `section-edge-0`) would give complete coverage of the behavioral fix.
